rationales.security: Herdr session startup changes OpenCode permission defaults and process coordination.
rationales.release: No packaged release is produced; delivery is managed configuration plus local deployment.
rationales.deploy: The repaired wrapper and restore helper must be applied to the active Aqua runtime.
rationales.operate: Recovered panes must preserve exact session identity and render after paced startup.
rationales.maintain_retire: The bounded pacing lock must recover from stale owners and remain removable with the wrapper.
